name: Wishcraft
source:
Star light, star bright,
First star I see tonight,
To her I pray, beneath this light
Grant this wish you wish tonight.

The last wishmaker lives deep in the woods, waiting for humans and monsters alike to fullfill their wishes.

But what if she has a wish for her own?
